title: Goobers hosted progress
description: Live, bounded projection published by a GitHub Actions-hosted Goobers run for portal rendering before the final journal artifact exists.

revision.description: Highest committed journal sequence represented by this projection.

actionsRunId.description: GitHub Actions workflow run database identifier.

actionsRunUrl.description: Human-facing URL for the owning GitHub Actions run.

identity.description: Canonical immutable identity pinned when the Goobers run started.

workflowDigest.description: Content digest of the pinned workflow definition.

gooberDigest.description: Content digest of participating resolved goobers.

trigger.description: Trigger kind and optional provider-specific reference.

startedAt.description: UTC time at which the Goobers run was created.

graph.description: Pinned canonical workflow graph used to render the live run.

events.description: Ordered projection of transition and operator-relevant canonical journal events.

updatedAt.description: UTC time at which this projection was generated.

truncatedBefore.description: First retained sequence after payload bounding removed older projected events.
